artworks.title: Egg-sellers, 1st plate (Les marchandes d'oeufs)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the mid-torso upwards, placed beside each other. They wear cloaks with hoods covering their heads and have simple facial features. The figure on the left may appear older, while the one on the right looks younger. Their cloaks partly cover their bodies. In front of them, a basket with a looped handle sits on the ground. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures and the basket.

artworks.title: The Gate (L'entree du champ)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with undulating terrain. A path or track is seen curving through the scene, with stone walls on both sides. The path leads toward a wooden gate in the distance. Rolling hills and vegetation extend into the background with the horizon subtly higher. The etching technique is evident in the linear strokes, hatching, and cross-hatching, providing texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and black, emphasizing the line work. The sky above is open and softly textured.

artworks.title: Squaring Logs (Homme que fend des buches)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a man engaged in an activity involving a thick piece of wood. Tall trees dominate the background and create a sense of enclosure. The style is reminiscent of etching with fine lines depicting textures of tree bark and foliage. The color palette consists of sepia tones, giving an antique quality to the image.

artworks.title: View of a Farm (La ferme des Bordes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is from a slightly elevated angle of a figure working with a long tool. The background shows bushes or low trees, with hills or a rocky outcrop beyond them. The illustration has cross-hatched lines and sketchy strokes, particularly evident in the rendering of trees and foliage. The color palette is predominantly sepia. Tall trees sweep from the lower right to upper left, and there is a suggestion of hills in the far distance.

artworks.title: Poor Man (Pauvre homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man. The man is depicted in a seated position, hunched over slightly, with his head tilted downward and slightly to one side. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, combined with a rugged, unshaven look. His hair appears short and thinning. He is wearing a long-sleeve garment that has visible folds and wrinkles. The fabric is subtly shaded, adding texture to the clothing. The man is holding an object close to his mouth with both hands. The background is dark and textured with cross-hatching lines.

artworks.title: Guardhouse (La maison du garde)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image shows a view through densely packed dark trees with wispy branches and leaves, framing a scene that draws the eye toward a structure partially visible behind the foliage. The building with a peaked roof is subtly obscured, nestled amidst the trees. The scene is etched with intricate, fine lines and crosshatching, depicting a richly textured environment. The horizon is not distinctly visible, suggesting that the structure lies beyond the immediate tree line without a clear demarcation from the sky. The color palette is subdued, primarily utilizing black ink on a cream or light tan surface. The technique emphasizes intricate linework and shading to convey depth and texture, with the style focusing on the interplay between light and shadow among the trees.

artworks.title: View of a Farm, 2nd plate (La ferme du Bienheureux)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching depicts a rural scene from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is visible along the upper third of the image, with small trees and shrubs obscuring it. A wooden structure with a pitched roof is partially hidden by a hill on the left side. The etched lines capture the detail of foliage and natural features. Grass and trees are depicted with intricate patterns of cross-hatching. The color palette is monochrome, with black lines on a soft off-white background.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beggar (Mendiant endormi)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a bench, leaning forward with their head resting on their left arm. Their face is partially obscured by their arm, revealing a scruffy beard and high cheekbones. The person's hair is curly and disheveled. They are wearing a loose-fitting garment that drapes over their body, with the material gathered at the elbows. The person's right hand holds a circular object. Their left leg is crossed over their right knee, partially obscuring the bottom half. Their legs appear to be wearing stockings, and they have shoes on their feet. The background is plain, with the bench providing horizontal texture.

artworks.title: Bohemien Encampment (Campement de bohemiens)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: In this image, we see the upper bodies of two figures seated closely together, each facing the other. The person on the left is resting their chin on their hand, although details of their facial features are not distinctively visible due to the sketch's shading. This individual has roughly styled hair. They are wearing a loose garment that blends into the large rock or mound they sit on. The person on the right has their back to the viewer and is fully covered by a flowing draped cloak, concealing their face and features. The background consists of textured, organic shapes and foliage, which give a sense of an outdoor setting. The sketch is simple, with fine lines and shading adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Victim of a Fire (Victime d'un incendie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man and a lying child, both depicted from head to toe. The man is in a reclined sitting position, with his legs extended and his back resting against a large bundle or sack. He has a bearded face with long hair. The man appears to be nude or minimally clothed. Beside him, on the ground, lies a child who appears to be sleeping. The child has curly hair and is dressed in a small garment. The setting includes several indistinct outlines of another figure in the background to the left and what appears to be cylindrical shapes on the right. The entire scene is rendered in a sketchy style with visible lines used for shading.

artworks.title: Old Inn (Une ancienne auberge)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a homestead nestled in nature. The horizon is obscured by cottage buildings and trees, showing a glimpse of sky in the upper part. The etching technique uses fine lines and crosshatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on pale paper. In the foreground, there is a wooden fence leading up a hill, while in the distance, trees and buildings are visible. There is a person and a horse near the trees on the left.

artworks.title: Fire, 3rd plate (L'incendie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: Two figures are shown in a seated side view. The figure on the left is an older person with a slightly elongated nose and discernible chin, short wavy hair, and a long draped garment. They are seated close to the other figure, both facing the right side. A staff or rod-like object is on the ground near the older figure. The figure on the right is in a crouched stance, with a youthful face, smooth skin, and longer hair tied back. Both figures wear flowing garments. The background is dark and textured, suggesting an enclosed setting with subtle wooden or stone features. In the upper center-left, a window or opening shows a hint of outdoor light or sky, illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: Woodcutters, 3rd plate (Les bucherons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures working with tools in a forested area. The setting is a wooded scene with large trees. The figures are depicted with intricate lines, conveying movement and effort as they handle tools, possibly for chopping or handling wood. The detailing includes shading and textural lines that form the contours of the bodies and the surrounding trees. The posture and positioning of the figures suggest a sense of laborious work amidst a natural backdrop, capturing a moment of manual toil with a dynamic interplay of light and shadow across the scene.

artworks.title: In the Forest (Lisiere de foret)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a dense forest landscape viewed from ground level. The horizon is indistinct, with sparse trees and open land in the background. The trees are depicted with bending trunks and detailed branching and foliage. The artwork features cross-hatching and stippling for texture and shadows. The monochrome palette includes shades of black and gray, adding depth to the scene. Closest to the viewer are thick tree trunks and undergrowth, leading to a lighter area in the distance, possibly indicating a clearing.

artworks.title: Death and the Philosopher (La mort et le philosophe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated at a table with the upper half of his body visible and slightly hunched over while writing. His face is partially obscured in shadow, revealing deep-set eyes under furrowed brows and a prominent nose, with his white hair and beard adding to his aged appearance. The man is wearing a loose-fitting shirt. He is holding a quill in his hand, writing something on the table surface. To the right of the man, a mysterious spectral figure, with a skeletal face, holds a candle that casts a faint light across the scene. The background is filled with intricate, dark crosshatch shading.

artworks.title: The Cooper (Le tonnelier)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a thatched-roof building on the left, a horse under the structure, and a man in a hat bending over a barrel on the right. The artwork is characterized by parallel lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette consists of varying shades of brown and black. In the background, there are simple foliage and a structure with a tiled roof visible, along with trees and bushes on the horizon.

artworks.title: Chailli Seen in a Storm (Chailli: Effet d'orage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is obscured by a dense gathering of trees and a small structure in the distance. The etching technique consists of intricate, cross-hatched strokes adding texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with deep blacks, grays, and a creamy paper color. The elements closer to us are textured to suggest fields or paths leading to the trees and structures. Lighting from the right side adds highlights to the foliage.

artworks.title: Man Watering a Horse (Homme abreuvant un cheval)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching shows a man drawing water from a stone trough or well with a horse drinking beside him. In the background, there are hill-like formations and structures resembling rustic buildings. The image has fine and detailed lines capturing textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying intensities of black and gray. A figure is depicted on the right, lying or sitting on the ground surrounded by lines suggesting grass or hay. The land behind them fades into a soft sky.

artworks.title: Sunrise (Lever du soleil: L'automne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a hill rising on the left where a small building is perched near the top. The horizon is in the middle with the sun casting light across the scene. The etching has fine lines detailing the landscape, creating textures in the trees and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. Detailed foliage and a rocky path lead to the distant hill with the building. Linear patterns in the sky radiate from the sun.

artworks.title: Top of the Hill (Le haut de la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from an elevated point of view. The horizon shows rolling hills reaching into the distance, with faint outlines of mountains visible. A large tree is depicted on the right with detailed etching emphasizing the texture of bark and leaves. Linear brushstrokes capture the landscape and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with a sepia tone, creating a serene atmosphere. Gentle hills and trees are visible in the distance under a calm, overcast sky.

artworks.title: Siesta in the Country (Sieste dans la campagne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape. The scene features tall trees on the right side and a man reclining against a tree in the foreground. In the background, there are rolling hills. The linework is detailed with crosshatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, and the sky is depicted with subtle lines suggesting clouds and light rays.

artworks.title: Little Burner of Grass (Le petit bruleur d'herbe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene with various figures and structures. One figure is crouched in the foreground, with a pathway lined with vegetation leading into the distance where buildings and trees can be seen. The horizon is obscured, implying a secluded rural setting. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes and cross-hatching techniques to create texture and depth. The color palette ranges from light beige to deep brown, accentuating the detailed scene.

artworks.title: Wash-house, called "The Washerwomen" (Le lavoir, dite "Les Laveuses")
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wide view of a natural scene. The horizon is high in the frame, with hills blending into the sky. In the distance, there is a structure with a small tower. The etching style features fine lines and cross-hatching, creating texture in trees and water. The color palette is earthy with browns and creams dominating. Two figures are crouched by the water, engaged in an activity. Trees frame the edges of the image, guiding the viewer's gaze towards the center.

artworks.title: Large Spaniard (Le grand Espagnol)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of an elderly man. He is positioned at a three-quarter angle, looking to the right. The man has a pronounced nose, a strong jawline, and deeply set eyes. His hair is short, slightly wavy, and shows signs of aging. He is dressed in a buttoned vest and a draped garment or coat that falls over his shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain.
